editorial.title: Editorial workspace
editorial.intro: Review evidence, keep a clear publication history.
editorial.webOnly: Open the editorial workspace in a web browser.
editorial.error: The request failed. Check your connection and try again.
editorial.conflict: The material changed or does not meet publication requirements. Refresh and check sources, review and dates.
editorial.invalid: Check required fields, dates, HTTPS URLs and DOI format.
editorial.immutable: Saved text is preserved. To correct it, create a new version and request a new review.
editorial.noSources: Add supporting scientific evidence before submission.
editorial.removeCitation: Remove citation with the reason below
editorial.reviewChecked: I checked the full text, sources, uncertainty, limitations and reuse rights.
editorial.causalityApproved: The evidence supports the causal interpretation.
editorial.confirmPublish: This version will become public and replace the current publication.
editorial.confirmArchive: The material will be hidden. Withdrawing evidence also hides articles that depend on this exact version.
editorial.notReviewed: This article version has not been approved.

editorialBlog.invalid: Check the title, article text, category and source links. Images must be PNG/JPEG, up to 5 MB and 20 megapixels.
editorialBlog.emptyTitle: A space for your next story
editorialBlog.heading: Heading
editorialBlog.evidenceHint: Link the research and evidence behind your article. Add at least one source before publication or review.
editorialBlog.imageHint: PNG or JPEG, up to 5 MB. Article images are center-cropped to 1600 × 900 px; content images keep their proportions.
editorialBlog.confirmPublish: Publish this version now? It will be available through the public API without an independent review.
editorialBlog.confirmArchive: Withdraw this article and its active versions from the public library?

discover.empty: Published material will appear here. Try another topic or return later.
discover.notFound: This publication is unavailable or has been withdrawn.
discover.evidenceUnavailable: Published evidence is unavailable. Do not treat this material as a verified claim.

discover.reviewDue: The scheduled review date has passed. New evidence may change this assessment.

learning.title: Learn with evidence
learning.intro: Explore reviewed research at your own pace. No timer, streak or penalties.
learning.flashcardIntro: Read a reviewed claim, reveal its explanation, then explore the evidence and limitations.
learning.emptyQuizzes: No quizzes are published in this language yet. You can explore flashcards in the meantime.
learning.emptyCards: No reviewed evidence cards are published in this language yet.
learning.loadError: We could not load learning content. Please try again.
learning.unavailable: This quiz is unavailable or its evidence has changed. Reload to see current material.
learning.noPressure: Take your time. You can repeat everything. Answers describe research, not your health.
learning.guestProgress: You can learn without an account. Progress stays in this session and is not saved.
learning.progressPrivacy: Optional: save educational progress to your account. This stores selected quiz options and reviewed evidence versions, without health or drinking data. Enabling loads saved progress; new answers are saved while enabled.
learning.forgetConfirm: Delete all saved quiz answers and flashcard progress from your account?
learning.forgotten: Saved learning progress deleted. Saving is now off.
learning.saveError: Progress could not be loaded or saved. Please try again.
learning.answerError: The answer could not be checked or saved. Check your connection and try again; if evidence was withdrawn, reload the quiz.
learning.repeatNote: Every explanation is an opportunity to learn. Repeat whenever you like; nothing is deducted.
learning.keepLearning: Let’s explore the explanation. You can try again when you repeat the quiz.

editor.title: Quiz editorial workspace
editor.reviewPolicy: Publish directly or send your quiz for review. Add an explanation of the correct answer and a research source to each question. No separate Evidence card is required.
editor.error: This operation failed. Check your permissions and required fields, including source titles and valid HTTPS links.
editor.archiveConfirm: Withdraw this quiz? It will disappear from public learning.
editor.language: Content language (reviewed translations are authored separately)
editor.explanationHint: Explain the evidence, uncertainty and why the reviewed answer is appropriate. Include an “unknown / depends” option when the evidence does not support a binary answer.
editor.discard: Leave and discard this unsaved quiz?
editor.sourceHint: Full HTTPS publication or DOI address, e.g. https://doi.org/…
editor.requiredFields: To publish, complete the quiz title and every question, answer options, correct answer, explanation, and at least one source with a title and HTTPS link.
